sloka: अहोरात्राण्यनेकानि वसन्तौ क्रोधमीयतुः ।ऊचतुश्च महात्मानौ तावुभौ द्विजसत्तमौ ॥क्रुद्धौ परमसम्प्राप्तौ वाक्यं घोराभिसंहितम् ।। ७.५३.१७ ॥
transliteration: ahorātrāṇyanekāni vasantau krodhamīyatuḥ ।ūcatuśca mahātmānau tāvubhau dvijasattamau ॥kruddhau paramasamprāptau vākyaṁ ghorābhisaṁhitam ।। 7.53.17 ॥

translations.english: After staying for many days and nights, those two great-souled and best among brahmins became exceedingly angry and spoke terrible words filled with a curse.
